title: add-conversational-toolbinding-playground-and-compact-dev-sandbox
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds a compact conversational tool-binding playground (TS + Python shims), a one-file dev sandbox via docker-compose, and a short quickstart doc with telemetry examples. No breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: developers asked for a minimal, runnable playground that demonstrates lightweight tool-binding patterns for RAG agents, streaming tool-call payloads, and simple telemetry hooks that work out-of-the-box. This PR delivers a compact dev sandbox and a focused example that teams can clone and run in under 2 minutes. Changes: 1) examples/toolbinding-playground: new runnable example (TypeScript agent shim, small Python retriever mock, tool adapters for http/webhook and local fs search); 2) docs/quickstarts/toolbinding-playground.md: step-by-step quickstart with suggested prompts and expected outputs; 3) ci/playground-smoke.yml: small smoke CI job that boots the playground and asserts agent responds to a canned tool call; 4) examples/toolbinding-playground/telemetry: OTLP-compatible mapping and a lightweight Prometheus exposition helper; 5) example docker-compose.yml: single-file dev sandbox that wires the agent, retriever, and a mock tool service. Key behaviors demonstrated: streaming responses with interleaved tool-calls (server-sent-events-friendly), tool result attribution in the trace/metric tags (tool.name, tool.latency_ms, tokens.generated), graceful fallback to a local text-only mode when remote tool is unavailable, and a small eval harness for reproducible prompt regression checks. Usage summary (from the quickstart): git clone ... && cd examples/toolbinding-playground && docker-compose up --build; open http://localhost:8080/playground; run the sample "invoice_summarize_with_receipt_search" scenario; observe streaming tokens and a separate tool-call event stream; inspect telemetry at http://localhost:9090/metrics or export traces to an OTLP collector. Files changed (high level): examples/toolbinding-playground/README.md, examples/toolbinding-playground/docker-compose.yml, examples/toolbinding-playground/src/agent.ts, examples/toolbinding-playground/src/tool-adapters/httpTool.ts, examples/toolbinding-playground/src/tool-adapters/fsSearch.ts, examples/toolbinding-playground/src/retriever_mock.py, docs/quickstarts/toolbinding-playground.md, ci/playground-smoke.yml, examples/toolbinding-playground/telemetry/otlp_mapping.yaml, examples/toolbinding-playground/telemetry/prom_exporter.ts, examples/toolbinding-playground/test/smoke.spec.ts, examples/toolbinding-playground/LICENSE.md. Commits summary: a) initial playground scaffold and README; b) add TS agent shim and tool adapters; c) add python retriever mock and interop glue; d) add telemetry mapping and basic Prom exporter; e) add CI smoke job and quickstart doc; f) polish prompts and add regression harness. Testing & CI: new smoke CI boots the sandbox and runs a small scenario that verifies the agent calls the fsSearch tool and returns a streaming response; unit tests cover tool adapter parsing and telemetry tag emission; CI initially failed due to flaky docker-compose network ordering, fixed by adding a simple wait-for script and healthcheck in docker-compose. Review notes: reviewers requested clearer guidance on when to use the local retriever mock vs. a production retriever (addressed in quickstart), and a short section on how to map tool-call telemetry to Redwood Console spans (added OTLP mapping example). Security: the mock tool runs on an internal port and the compose file documents that it is not meant for production; no credentials checked into the example. Backwards compatibility: none of the changes touch runtime or API surfaces; purely example/docs/CI. Merge: squash-merged after CI passed and all reviewers approved. Impact: this gives a low-friction example for engineers exploring tool-calling RAG patterns with streaming and telemetry; intended to be used in workshops and onboarding.
